thread:
maria: Heads-up: target release tomorrow 09:00 PT. Need final changelog, docs links, and webinar slot confirmed. /cc @ben @sasha
ben: On it — changelog PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/changelog/pull/312 :eyes:
sasha: Docs update is in review, ETA today EOD. Will pin links here when merged.
priya: Webinar slot confirmed for Thurs 10am PT. Need slides + short demo checklist.
jake: Can we stagger the rollout? Recommend canary -> 10% -> 50% -> 100% over 2 hours to monitor latencies.
maria: Yes. Marketing wants exact timings and fallback messaging for customers.
ben: Deploy plan:
```
- 09:00 canary -> 10% traffic
- 09:30 50%
- 10:00 100%
- auto rollback on error >= 5xx rate or latency > 2x baseline
```
sasha: Docs links when merged:
- https://docs.redwood.ai/release/2026-03-24
- https://docs.redwood.ai/updates/optimize-batching
maria: Priya, can you confirm inbound lead routing? We need triage tags and webhook to SDR queue.
priya: Routing: set utm=announce -> webhook -> salesforce queue 'announce-inbound', and send immediate +1d nurture email.
priya: I'll share the webhook URL and mapping in the #support channel after lunch.
jake: Also recommend a short alert to eng-oncall if latency bump >20% in first 30 min.
ben: Adding that to rollout runbook. I'll attach runbook link once PR merges.
deploy-bot: Deployment scheduled: canary at 5074109999. Monitoring hooks enabled.
maria: Great. Last ask: an inline changelog snippet for the release tweet thread. @sasha can you draft 2 variants (short + expanded) by 17:00?
sasha: Drafted. Short: "Faster inference, lower cost — rolling out new batching and routing improvements. Docs + benchmarks: <link>" Expanded: "Today we're rolling out a release that improves per-token cost with smarter batching, introduces model routing by latency tiers, and adds a new Optimize dashboard. Read the changelog & benchmarks: <link> — webinar Thurs 10am PT".
ben: Approved. QA note: please include model list and known breaking changes in the detailed changelog.
maria: Perfect. I'll assemble final announce package (tweet thread, blog, assets, webinar link) and drop it here when ready. :rocket:
priya: I'll put SDR playbook + nurture copy in Notion and paste link.
jake: Any objections to 2-hour post-launch monitoring window for marketing metrics? Sounds good to me.
maria: No objections. Thanks team — sync again in 30m for final sign-off. :thumbsup:
